name: Transductive Centered Prototype Refinement
tagline: Cosine ProtoNet at training; at test, centers features by support+query mean and refines prototypes for 15 transductive iterations using soft query assignments.

key_hyperparams.name: support_weight
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of support mean kept each step

key_hyperparams.name: query_weight
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of soft query mean added

init_recovers: Cosine ProtoNet at training; standard ProtoNet if refinement disabled
diff_from_baseline: Versus ProtoNet, switches to cosine logits with learned temperature, adds task-adaptive centering using both support and query means, then refines each prototype for 15 steps via a 0.7-0.3 mixture of support mean and soft-query-weighted mean.

name: Diagonal-Mahalanobis Prototypes
tagline: ProtoNet with per-class diagonal-Mahalanobis distance, where the variance is a learnable mixture of class-specific and global support variance.

key_hyperparams.name: alpha
key_hyperparams.role: sigmoid mixing of class vs global variance

diff_from_baseline: Versus ProtoNet's negative-Euclidean scoring, replaces it with a diagonal squared-Mahalanobis distance using per-class variance interpolated with global variance via a sigmoid gate, scaled by a learnable temperature.

name: Self-Attended Prototypes + Cross-Attended Queries
tagline: ProtoNet with a 1-layer Transformer over the N prototypes, then a query→prototype cross-attention block; scoring is scaled cosine plus a prototype-orthogonality regularizer.
formula: $$P = \mathrm{TransformerEnc}(\mu_1,\dots,\mu_N),\quad q' = \mathrm{LN}(q + \mathrm{MHA}(q, P, P)),\quad q'' = \mathrm{LN}(q' + \mathrm{FFN}(q')),$$ $$\mathrm{score}(q, c) = \tau\,\frac{q''}{\|q''\|}\cdot\frac{P_c}{\|P_c\|},\qquad \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{CE} + 0.1\cdot\overline{\mathrm{ReLU}\!\big(\hat P\hat P^\top - I\big)}.$$

key_hyperparams.name: n_heads
key_hyperparams.role: MHA heads in self- and cross-attention

init_recovers: ProtoNet (cosine) when both attention modules are zero-output
diff_from_baseline: Versus ProtoNet, runs 1 Transformer-encoder layer over the N class prototypes (so prototypes adapt to one another) and a cross-attention residual on each query against those task-aware prototypes; auxiliary loss penalizes positive cosine off-diagonals between prototypes.

name: Episodic Residual Mahalanobis Prototypes (ERMP)
tagline: Gated prototypes plus FiLM-modulated queries scored by a learnable softmax mixture of cosine + diagonal-Mahalanobis + L2; loss is CE + margin + entropy regularizer.
formula: $$g_c = \sigma(\mathrm{MLP}(\mu_c)),\quad \hat\mu_c = g_c\odot\mu_c,\quad \sigma^2_c = g_c^2\odot\widehat{\mathrm{Var}}_c + 5{\cdot}10^{-4},$$ $$(\gamma, \beta) = \mathrm{MLP}([q;\bar{\hat\mu}]),\quad \hat q = q\odot(1 + 0.1\tanh\gamma) + 0.1\beta,$$ $$w = \mathrm{softmax}(\mathrm{MLP}([\bar{\hat\mu}; \bar{\sigma^2}])),\ \mathrm{score}(\hat q, c) = |s|\!\cdot\!\big(w_0\cos + w_1(-\overline{(\hat q-\hat\mu_c)^2/\sigma^2_c}) + w_2(-\overline{(\hat q-\hat\mu_c)^2})\big).$$
init_recovers: Cosine ProtoNet when w → [1,0,0] and gates → 1, FiLM modulation → 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus ProtoNet, gates each prototype by a learned sigmoid, runs a query FiLM modulator conditioned on episode context, scores via a softmax mixture of cosine, diagonal-Mahalanobis, and L2 with task-conditioned weights, and adds margin + entropy regularizers to CE.

name: Cross-Attn ProtoNet + Adaptive FiLM (CAPT)
tagline: ProtoNet with 4-head cross-attention where queries attend to prototypes, then queries are FiLM-shifted using prototype mean+std and scored as a learnable cosine/L2 blend.
formula: $$\hat q = \mathrm{LN}\!\big(q + W_o\,\mathrm{MHA}_4(W_q q,\,W_k\mu,\,W_v\mu)\big),\qquad q' = \frac{\hat q - \bar{\hat q}}{s_{\hat q}},$$ $$(\gamma, \beta) = \mathrm{MLP}([\bar\mu; s_\mu]),\quad q'' = \gamma\odot q' + \beta,$$ $$\mathrm{score} = \mathrm{softmax}\,\big(\sigma(f)\,\cos(q''\tau_c, \mu) + (1-\sigma(f))\,(-\|q''\tau_l - \mu\|^2/10)\big).$$

key_hyperparams.name: tau_L2
key_hyperparams.role: scale before L2; output divided by 10

init_recovers: ProtoNet-like (50/50 cos+L2) when attention is zero and FiLM is identity
diff_from_baseline: Versus ProtoNet, adds 4-head query→prototype cross-attention with residual+LayerNorm, then standardizes the queries and applies an MLP-FiLM (γ,β) computed from prototype mean+std, finally scoring as a learnable convex combination of cosine and L2.
